game.title: Silent Hill 2
game.blurb: Psychological survival horror remake of the 2001 game, set in the fog-bound town of Silent Hill, from Bloober Team, released 2024-10-08. RAWG average playtime: 1 hour. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story
chapters.summary: Exploring the town and the places beyond it. Almost all story achievements are hidden. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Fighting Back
chapters.summary: Stomp finishers and kills with melee and ranged weapons.

chapters.title: Exploration and Memos
chapters.summary: Trying locked doors, breaking windows and collecting every memo in one playthrough.

chapters.title: New Game Plus and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: New Game Plus, finishing without the radio, without ranged kills, or in under 10 hours.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Remake of the 2001 game: this entry uses the remake's own RAWG entry ("silent-hill-2-remake", id 868086) and Steam app 2124490 ("SILENT HILL 2"); RAWG keeps the 2001 original as a separate entry ("silent-hill-2", id 29642). No StrategyWiki page under "Silent Hill 2 (2024)" or "Silent Hill 2 (remake)"; a StrategyWiki search for "Silent Hill 2" finds only the guide for the 2001 original (filed under 2001 and PlayStation 2, completion stage 0), which was not used. silenthill.fandom.com redirects "Silent Hill 2 (2024)" to "Silent Hill 2 (2024 video game)", with about 166 linked pages, including place names such as "Blue Creek Apartments", "Wood Side Apartments", "Brookhaven Hospital", "Toluca Lake" and "Lakeview Hotel", and a "Silent Hill 2 (2024 video game) secrets and unlockables" page; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Noise" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2124490 as "SILENT HILL 2". 33 of 43 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter, so the story is not split into parts; Fandom's place names were not used to order chapters. RAWG lists a playtime of only 1 hour, which looks wrong.
